topic_title: Value of ADE — Foundations for Reduced-Risk Driving
prompt: When encountering adverse driving conditions such as heavy rain or fog, how does Texas law require a driver to adapt their operating speed?

options.text: Reduce speed below the posted limit to what is reasonable and prudent
Maintain the posted speed limit to prevent sudden rear-end collisions
Drive five miles per hour under the limit with hazard lights flashing
Match the speed of surrounding traffic regardless of reduced traction
